bio: The Bonham is a luxury boutique hotel situated in the West End of Edinburgh, set in a quiet residential crescent surrounded by the stunning backdrop of this magnificent capital city.  Afternoon Tea at The Bonham is served in the hotels new bar. The Consulting Room is a welcome addition to the hotel where guests can enjoy an early evening glass of wine, meet with a group or friends for Afternoon Tea or enjoy a variety of great cocktails.  Their menu features a selection of classic sandwiches, freshly baked scones and cakes, accompanied with a range of Brodies oriental teas and infusions from all around the world.  The Bonham Hotel is conveniently located in the West End of Edinburgh, surrounded by the finest gardens and beautiful Georgian streets of the New Town. It is a short walk from Edingburgh Castle and is situated close to the Haymarket train station.
